1  MFA No. 301 of 2020

THIS MFA IS FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 02.07.2019 PASSED IN MVC NO.
600/2016 ON THE FILE OF THE JUDGE, PRINCIPAL COURT OF SMALL CAUSES, AS A PRESIDING OFFICER, MOTOR ACCIDENTS CLAIMS TRIBUNAL, MYSURU, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENCHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:

JUDGMENT Heard the learned counsel for the appellant and respondent No.2.
2.
On the last occasion, it was submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant that MFA.No.294/2022 was filed by the same claimant for enhancement of compensation.

Now it is submitted that the said MFA.No.294/2022 has been settled in the Lok-Adalat and the respondent has agreed to pay a sum of Rs.80,000/- in addition to what has already been awarded by the Tribunal.
3.
Learned counsel for the appellant also submit that the claimant had filed the said MFA.No.294/2022 without her knowledge through another advocate.
Therefore, she would withdraw the present appeal.
Hence, the present appeal being infructuous as the lis is settled in MFA.No.294/2022 before the Lok-Adalat, the same is dismissed as withdrawn.
Learned counsel for the appellant is permitted to file memo for withdrawal within a period of two days from today.

Sd/-
